breadth_audit.sunday_retrospective_note: Sunday edition closing the three-lab frontier launch week (OpenAI GPT-5.6 GA + xAI Grok 4.5 + Anthropic Claude Cowork within 48h). Most topics continue fading off the launch-week spike via slow-EMA smoothing; the day's genuinely NEW structural signals are (1) enterprise MCP convergence — ServiceNow/Snowflake/Salesforce/SAP all standardizing on MCP the same week, lifting agent-platforms-enterprise + mcp-adoption breadth; (2) Meituan LongCat-2.0, first trillion-param model trained wholly on domestic Chinese silicon, adding meituan as a new open-weight actor; (3) VentureBeat 'context architecture displacing RAG'; (4) Apple's trade-secret suit against OpenAI as the loudest dev thread (1,622 pts).

thresholds._comment: Lowered 2026-06-03 from 15/20 alongside BREADTH_PLAN actor-attribution. Removing publishers + contrast co-mentions shrinks every topic's org set, so the old 15/20 floor (set against the inflated distribution) would almost never fire. After the first corrected radar run, read breadth_audit.median_breadth_30d and re-tune: high_breadth_7d ~= top-third of the NEW distribution, very_high ~= top-quartile.
